title: HANDLE CONDITION labels inside a PERFORM THRU range, an ERROR catch-all outside it, RESP and IGNORE overriding HANDLE

scenarios.summary: HCQ1 holds three 3-byte items: the loop reads them, ITEMERR on item 4 jumps to PAST-END inside the PERFORM range, which returns to MAIN-PARA
HCQ1 does not exist: QIDERR jumps to NO-QUEUE, which falls through PAST-END into READ-ITEMS-EXIT and returns from the PERFORM
HCQ1 holds five items: the loop ends normally and control falls through NO-QUEUE and PAST-END although no condition occurred
item 1 is 1 byte, so LENGTH is left at 1; item 2 is 5 bytes: LENGERR, no specific handler, so the ERROR label outside the PERFORM range takes it
